title: Integrations
subtitle: Connect Mault to other apps and choose what gets posted where.

discord.botUnreachable: Couldn't reach the Discord bot, so channel names and permissions can't be shown right now.
discord.botNotInServer: The bot isn't in your linked server anymore. Add it back, then link again.

channelSettings.heading: Channels
channelSettings.description: Where every scan, every error or alert and every new trade offer gets posted. Only owners and admins can change these.
channelSettings.roleHint: Pick a role to mention with each post, including posts to collection override channels. The role must be mentionable by the bot.

overrides.heading: Collection overrides
overrides.description: Send one collection's scans or errors to a different channel. Collections without an override use the channels above.
overrides.empty: No overrides. Every collection uses the channels above.

overrideDialog.title: Add collection override
overrideDialog.description: Pick a collection and where its scans or errors should go instead.
overrideDialog.noCollections: No matching collections without an override.

notifications.heading: Notifications
notifications.description: Turn the every-scan feed on or off, and send a test message to check your channels.

rules.heading: Notification rules
rules.description: Post a card to a channel when it matches a rule. Every matching rule posts, so one card can go to several channels, but each channel gets it once.
rules.needsGame: Pick a collection with a game to add notification rules.
rules.noChannel: No channel. Edit the rule to pick one.
rules.limitReached_one: Your plan includes {{count}} Discord notification rule. Upgrade your plan for more rules.
rules.limitReached_other: Your plan includes {{count}} Discord notification rules. Upgrade your plan for more rules.

ruleDialog.description: When a scanned card matches these conditions, it's posted to this channel.
ruleDialog.name: Name
ruleDialog.roleHint: Mentions this role when a card matches. Greyed-out roles can't be pinged by the bot: make them mentionable in Discord, or give the bot the "Mention @everyone, @here, and All Roles" permission.

draft.saveFailed: Some Discord settings couldn't be saved. Try again.

apiKeys.heading: API keys
apiKeys.description: Let your own systems, like an online shop, read this organization's cards and storage locations. Keys belong to the organization, not to you, so they keep working if you leave.
apiKeys.revokeConfirmDescription: Anything using it stops working right away. This can't be undone.
apiKeys.createDescription: Give the key a name so you can tell later what uses it.
apiKeys.writeDescription: Read-only keys can list cards, collections and storage locations. Keys with write access can also take cards out of their box, move them to another box and delete them.
apiKeys.revealDescription: This is the only time the full key is shown. Store it somewhere safe, like your shop's secret settings.
apiKeys.managersOnly: Only organization owners and admins can create or revoke API keys.
apiKeys.upgrade: API keys are not part of your plan.
apiKeys.tryIt: Try it in the API reference

api.heading: API
api.subtitle: Let your own systems, like an online shop, look up which box every card is in.

webhooks.heading: Webhooks
webhooks.description: Mault posts an event to your URL when cards are scanned or put away into a storage location. Each webhook has its own signing secret so you can check a request really came from Mault.
webhooks.dialogDescription: Mault sends a signed POST request with a JSON body to this URL. It must be a public https:// address.

card.scanned: A card was scanned and saved to a collection.

cards.stored: A bin was put away into a storage location. Includes each card's box and position.

sorter.alert: A sorter jammed, errored, restarted, lost its connection or is due for service.

webhooks.deleteConfirmDescription: Mault stops sending events to this URL right away. This can't be undone.
webhooks.secretDescription: Use it to verify the X-Mault-Signature header on every request. This is the only time it's shown.
webhooks.upgrade: Webhooks are not part of your plan.

key.heading: Self-hosted stats sync
key.description: Running Mault on your own server? Generate a key here and enter it on your server under Settings > Integrations. Your server then sends its scan totals here once a day, starting with every day you've already scanned. Only daily scan counts are sent, never cards, photos or collections. Synced scans show on the leaderboard marked as self-hosted, and viewers can hide them.
key.generateFailed: Couldn't generate a stats sync key.
key.revokeFailed: Couldn't revoke the stats sync key.
key.loadFailed: Couldn't load the stats sync key.
key.empty: No self-hosted server is linked to this organization.
key.managersOnly: Only organization owners and admins can manage the stats sync key.
key.revealDescription: This is the only time the full key is shown. Paste it into your self-hosted server under Settings > Integrations.
key.copyFailed: Couldn't copy the stats sync key.
key.regenerateConfirmDescription: The current key stops working right away, so your server can't sync until you enter the new key there. Scans already synced stay.
key.revokeConfirmDescription: Your server stops syncing right away. Scans already synced stay on the leaderboard.

connection.heading: Sync stats to Mault
connection.description: Add this organization's scan counts to the Mault leaderboards. Create an organization on {{url}}, generate a stats sync key under Settings > Integrations and paste it here. Every scan you've made so far is sent first, then new totals once a day. Only daily scan counts are sent, never cards, photos or collections.
connection.keyDescription: Generated by your organization on the main Mault site.
connection.connectFailed: The main Mault site didn't accept this key. Check that you copied all of it and that it hasn't been revoked or replaced.
connection.disconnectConfirmDescription: New scans stop being sent. Scans already synced stay on the main site until the key is revoked there.
connection.loadFailed: Couldn't load the stats sync settings.
connection.managersOnly: Only organization owners and admins can manage stats sync.
connection.notConnected: This organization doesn't sync its stats.

errors.invalidKey: The main site no longer accepts this key. Generate a new key there, then disconnect and connect again.
errors.unreachable: Couldn't reach the main Mault site. It will try again within an hour.
errors.rejected: The main Mault site rejected the last sync. It will try again within an hour.
